dedupe_keys.name: gmtra global multihazard transport risk analysis of road and railway assets koks et al 2019

description: GMTRA provides the code for a global risk analysis of road and railway assets under earthquakes, floods and cyclones, with notebooks that reproduce the 2019 Nature Communications study by Koks and co-authors. The study gave the first global estimates of multi-hazard exposure and risk to road and rail infrastructure: about 27 percent of assets are exposed to at least one hazard and 7.5 percent to a 1-in-100 year flood; expected annual damages range from 3.1 to 22 billion US dollars, about 73 percent from surface and river flooding, reaching 0.5 to 1 percent of GDP in some countries; and more flood protection pays off for about 60 percent of roads exposed to a 1-in-100 year flood. Inputs are OpenStreetMap (planet file of 17 July 2018), GAR 2015 hazards, Fathom flood maps used with permission, JRC coastal maps and a global liquefaction map. Coverage: global. Format and access: open code and article. Licence and cost: AGPL-3.0 code, CC BY 4.0 article, free. Caveats: the Fathom flood data are licensed. It supports hazard exposure, climate adaptation and resilience studies of transport networks. It relates to OpenStreetMap, open-gira, GIRI, the port multi-hazard risk data and the record-breaking extremes study in the catalogue.
